[WFLA News Channel 8] Pair of spacecraft draw closer to Mercury after nearly decade-long voyage
item.description: Two Mercury-bound spacecraft left their mother ship behind on Thursday and headed down the home stretch of their nearly decade-long voyage to the solar system's smallest and closest-to-the-sun planet.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Missouri court blocks Trump-backed US House map and orders it to be put to a vote

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] DeSantis says he'll help sell Amendment 3 as local opposition grows
item.description: Gov. Ron DeSantis says he will help persuade Floridians to approve Amendment 3, lending his political backing to a property-tax proposal facing growing opposition from local leaders.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Ex-analyst Mark Sanchez plans guilty plea ahead of trial stemming from fight
item.description: Former Fox Sports analyst Mark Sanchez plans to plead guilty to charges ahead of a trial stemming from an October 2025 fight with a truck driver outside an Indianapolis hotel.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] You may have seen it. You may have felt it. Here is what helicopters are spraying to fight dengue in Tampa
item.description: Tampa Bay 28's Jada Williams went inside Hillsborough County Mosquito Management and spoke with officials from two counties about the aerial fight against dengue — an operation they say is unlike anything the region has seen in nearly 100 years.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Vance says Iran conflict isn’t a ‘war,’ as he refuses to say when it will end
item.description: Vice President JD Vance could provide neither a timeline for the Iran war to end nor a date when gas prices might sink below pre-war levels during a White House appearance Thursday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump administration asks Supreme Court to allow mail-in voting limits before midterms
item.description: The Trump administration is again asking the Supreme Court to allow sweeping new mail-in voting restrictions — just two months before the November midterms.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Thieves stealing SNAP benefits from Florida families are using the tax dollars to buy baby formula
item.description: More than a dozen Florida families have reported stolen SNAP benefits connected to a single address in Glendale, California. The I-Team found a majority of the purchases are for baby formula.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pasco County program helps school employees become teachers
item.description: Teach Pasco Paid Pathway provides financial assistance and continued pay during final internships for eligible employees pursuing education degrees.
